translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Ber bedo jachan ma wuodhe ok nyal cha,
moloyo ngʼat mofuwo ma lewe timo richo.
Ok ber bedo gi gombo maonge gi ngʼeyo,
kata bedo ka irikni kae to ibayo yo.
Fuwo mar ngʼato owuon ketho ngimane;
to bende chunye bedo mager gi Jehova Nyasaye.
Mwandu kelo osiepe mangʼeny,
to osiep ngʼat ma jachan ringe.
Janeno ma ja-miriambo ok notony ma ok okum,
to ngʼatno malando miriambo ok nobed thuolo.
Ji mangʼeny temo mondo oyud pwoch kuom ruoth,
to ngʼato ka ngʼato bedo osiep ngʼat machiwo mich.
Ngʼat ma jachan wedene duto kwede,
osiepene to noringe maromo nadi!
Kata bed notemo sayogi
onge kama doyudgie.
Ngʼatno moyudo rieko ohero chunye owuon,
to ngʼat mohero winjo wach dhi maber.
Janeno ma ja-miriambo ok notony ma ok okume,
to ngʼatno malando miriambo biro lal nono.
Ok en gima owinjore mondo ngʼat mofuwo odagi e ber,
to en gima rach machalo nadi ka misumba ema omi loch kuom yawuot ruoth!
Ngʼat mariek iye ok wangʼ piyo;
oyudo duongʼ kuom weyo wach ma ok odewo ketho.
Gero mar ruoth chalo gi sibuor maruto,
to ka omor kodi to ochalo gi tho manie wi lum.
Wuowi mofuwo kelone wuon mare masira,
to dhako maralep chalo gi kodh ajiki.
Ute kod mwandu gin girkeni miyudo kuom jonywol,
to dhako mariek aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
Samuoyo kelo nindo matut,
to ngʼat ma ja-mifwadhi bedo gi kech.
Ngʼatno morito chike Jehova Nyasaye kendo timo gik mopuonje biro dak amingʼa,
to ngʼat mochayo chikene biro tho.
Ngʼat manyiso ngʼwono ne jochan, holo mana Jehova Nyasaye,
obiro gwedhe kuom gik mosetimo.
Kum wuodi, nikech mano e kama geno nitie;
kik ibed e winjruok kuom gima nyalo kelone tho.
Ngʼat ma ja-mirima nyaka yud kum, kendo ka ikonye,
to chuno ni nyaka itim kamano kendo.
Chik iti ka ingʼadoni rieko kendo rwak puonj,
to giko ni inibed mariek.
Dhano nigi chenro mangʼeny e chunye,
to dwaro mar Jehova Nyasaye ema timore.
Gima dhano dwaro en hera ma ok rum,
ber bedo jachan moloyo bedo ja-miriambo.
Luoro Jehova Nyasaye tero ji e ngima;
eka ngʼato yweyo kodhil, ma ok omule gi chandruok.
Jasamuoyo luto lwete malal ei tawo;
kendo ok onyal gole oko moduoge e dhoge!
Chwad jasunga mondo joma ngʼeyogi tin opuonjre;
kwer ngʼat man-gi rieko, to obiro medo fwenyo tiend weche.
Ngʼat mamayo wuon mare kendo riembo min mare
en wuowi makelo wichkuot kod dwanyruok.
Kidagi chiko iti ne puonj in wuoda,
to ibiro bayo mabor kuom weche mag ngʼeyo.
Janeno ma ja-jar ji ochayo adiera,
to dho ngʼat ma timbene richo golo mana richo.
Kum oket mana ne jo-achaya,
to chwat ne ngʼe joma ofuwo.
